MODULUS = 1000000007

class MatStruct:
    def __init__(self, dim):
        self.dim = dim
        self.mat = [[0] * dim for _ in range(dim)]
        
    def __mul__(self, other):
        C = MatStruct(self.dim)
        for i in range(self.dim):
            for j in range(self.dim):
                total = 0
                for k in range(self.dim):
                    total += self.mat[i][k] * other.mat[k][j]
                C.mat[i][j] = total % MODULUS
        return C

def main():
    n_value, m_value = map(int, input().split())
    base = MatStruct(m_value + 1)
    identity = MatStruct(m_value + 1)
    for i in range(m_value + 1):
        base.mat[i][i] = 1
        base.mat[0][i] = 1
        identity.mat[i][i] = 1

    y_counter = 1
    y_powered = 1
    level_idx = 0
    total_sum = 0

    while y_powered * m_value <= n_value:
        y_powered *= m_value
        level_idx += 1

    bi_array = [[MatStruct(m_value + 1) for _ in range(m_value + 1)] for _ in range(level_idx + 1)]
    for t in range(level_idx + 1):
        if t > 0:
            bi_array[t][0] = bi_array[t - 1][0]
            for i in range(1, m_value + 1):
                bi_array[t][0] = bi_array[t][0] * bi_array[t - 1][i]
        for i in range(1, m_value + 1):
            bi_array[t][i] = bi_array[t][i - 1]
            for j in range(m_value - 1):
                for k in range(m_value + 1):
                    bi_array[t][i].mat[j][k], bi_array[t][i].mat[j + 1][k] = bi_array[t][i].mat[j + 1][k], bi_array[t][i].mat[j][k]
            for j in range(m_value - 1):
                for k in range(m_value + 1):
                    bi_array[t][i].mat[k][j], bi_array[t][i].mat[k][j + 1] = bi_array[t][i].mat[k][j + 1], bi_array[t][i].mat[k][j]

    currentMat = identity
    while total_sum < n_value:
        if total_sum + y_powered <= n_value:
            total_sum += y_powered
            currentMat = currentMat * bi_array[level_idx][0]
            y_counter = (y_counter + 1) % m_value
        else:
            y_powered //= m_value
            level_idx -= 1

    final_answer = 0
    for i in range(m_value + 1):
        final_answer = (final_answer + currentMat.mat[i][m_value]) % MODULUS
    print(final_answer)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
